info.title: Project Management API
info.description:
REST API for workspaces, projects, tasks, comments, labels and file attachments.

Generated from the implementation by `npm run docs:generate`. Authentication is cookie-based; see `docs/API.md` for the full guide.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: The authenticated user’s own profile and settings.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description: Project labels and their assignment to tasks.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: The per-project and per-task audit trail.

cookieAuth.name: accessToken
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and `Secure` in production. There is no bearer-token alternative.

Pagination.description: Present on every paginated list response.

User.description: A user. `password` is never present: it is `select: false` and stripped again on serialisation.

user.description: Populated as an object on read; a plain id when embedded in a list.

Workspace.description: `_id` is mapped to `id` on serialisation, as for User.

members.description: Present only for a caller with access to the project — a project member, or a workspace owner/admin. A workspace member who is not on the project can still read the project record (discovery), but the membership list is omitted: it carries member identities and is project-internal. `createdBy` is likewise reduced to an id for such a caller.

Attachment.description: Metadata only. Files are never served from a public path; use the download endpoint.

ProjectActivity.description: An append-only audit entry. Written by the service layer, never by a client.

action.description: See `docs/API.md` for the full action list.

MyTasks.description: Figures for the calling user only.

latencyMs.description: Present when the database is up.

reason.description: Present when the database is down.

MessageResponse.description: Success envelope for endpoints that return no payload.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope. `errors` is a list of field-level failures.
